newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel Broadway public tranche undersubcribed.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel Broadway public tranche undersubcribed.

text.p: NatSteel Broadway Ltd said on Tuesday its public tranche in an initial public offer in Singapore was undersubscribed due to weak market sentiment among retail investors.
The China-based NatSteel Broadway said about six million shares in the public tranche were not subcribed.

The integrated contract manufacturer of plastic and metal components for electronics products had offered 33.8 million shares at US$0.70 each in an IPO last month. Half of the shares were for the public and half privately placed.

NatSteel Broadway said it has taken up 3.1 million shares from the unsubcribed public tranche to raise its post-floatation shareholding to 51 percent from 48.7 percent in order to make NatSteel Broawady a subsidiary in the NatSteel group.
It added that the underwriters and Co-underwriter of the invitation would subscribe for the remaining 2.9 million offer shares.
DBS and OUB are joint lead managers and underwriters of the issue.
NatSteel Broadway reported last month its placement tranche of 16.9 million shares were fully taken up.
The shares would start trading on October 10 on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore Limited.
The company is a spin-off of NatSteel Ltd.
